title: Add optional `@workspace` agent and decision fields, hosted kit lock pins, and uniform `ia init --system` stewardship mandates
summary: Extend `@schema workspace` with optional `composition.public-agent`, `composition.private-agent` and `composition.decides` fields; advance distribution lock engine to `0.1.3` for offline-safe `hosted` kit pins with `archive` and `manifest` SHA-256 digests (`ia install --hosted`, `readHostedPins`, `source: hosted` in `ia_session` and `IA-CORE-KIT-HOSTED` in `ia_method`); and pair `@agent <id>-steward` uniformly with `@mandate <id>-stewardship` in `ia init --system`. Exported `LockEntry`, `KitOrigin`, `KitInstallation['via']` and `KitSource` unions widen to include `'hosted'`. A lock without a hosted pin keeps the engine marker 3.8.x reads, but every installation plan 3.9.0 saves (`ia-distribution plan install|update|remove|rollback … --out`, or `--plan-out` on `ia install`, `ia update` or `ia remove`) records engine `0.1.3`, whatever lock it plans: `ia-distribution apply --plan` of 3.8.x refuses such a plan, and 3.9.0 refuses one 3.8.x saved, both with `IA-DIST-INPUT-INVALID` ("Invalid installation plan"). `ia` itself plans and applies in one run, so only a saved plan is affected; make a fresh plan with the CLI that will apply it.
